title: Submit newsletter signup form with empty email field
preconditions: Footer newsletter signup section is visible
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup section
Leave the email input field empty
expected_result: Form does not submit successfully. A top banner displays 'There was a problem with your submission. Please review the fields below.' An inline error 'This field is required.' appears under the email field, and the field's aria-invalid attribute is set to 'true'.

title: Submit newsletter signup form with malformed email (missing @ symbol)
preconditions: Footer newsletter signup section is visible
steps: Scroll to the footer newsletter signup section
expected_result: Form does not submit successfully. Inline error 'The email address entered is invalid, please check the formatting (e.g. email@domain.com).' appears under the email field, and the field's aria-invalid attribute is set to 'true'.
